title: Smart Data Models - SIMPLE Federated Business Service - DischargeOrder
description: Order in which an organisation is made responsible of / agrees to discharge some cargo, e.g. inside a rail terminal (simple-bs:DischargeOrder, SIMPLE extension to the FEDeRATED Business Service ontology, subclass of Order, itself a subclass of BusinessTransaction).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DischargeOrder'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

createdBy.description: Property. businessService:createdBy (inherited from BusinessTransaction via Order). Creator of the business transaction.

hasSequenceNumber.description: Property. businessService:hasSequenceNumber (inherited from BusinessTransaction via Order).

transportPlanIssuanceTime.description: Property. businessService:transportPlanIssuanceTime (inherited from BusinessTransaction via Order).

transportPlanTotalNumber.description: Property. businessService:transportPlanTotalNumber (inherited from BusinessTransaction via Order).

dischargePortOfCall.description: Property. simple-bs:dischargePortOfCall (SIMPLE extension, domain BusinessTransaction, inherited via Order). Port attended within a voyage to discharge the cargo.

loadPortOfCall.description: Property. simple-bs:loadPortOfCall (SIMPLE extension, domain BusinessTransaction, inherited via Order). Port attended within a voyage to load the cargo.

summaryDeclaration.description: Property. simple-bs:summaryDeclaration. The Entry Summary Declaration number, required as a prerequisite for assigning a customs destination to goods introduced into a customs territory.

hasService.description: Relationship. businessService:hasService (inherited from BusinessTransaction via Order). The logistics service this order is part of. Range: LogisticsService (this candidate's TransportService or CargoHandlingService).

involvedActor.description: Relationship. businessService:involvedActor (inherited from BusinessTransaction via Order). Legal persons playing a role in this order. Range: LegalPerson (out of scope of this candidate).

involvedEvent.description: Relationship. businessService:involvedEvent (inherited from BusinessTransaction via Order). Logistics events involved with this order. Range: Event (out of scope of this candidate).

partOfTransportMovementType.description: Relationship. businessService:partOfTransportMovementType (inherited from BusinessTransaction via Order). Whether this order is part of main-, on- or pre-carriage. Range: Classifications:TransportMovementType (out of scope of this candidate).
